test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 08
subject: general
question: In the **Centralized Online Patient Feedback System** recently launched by the **Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)**, what is the specific service rating threshold that triggers an automated alert for immediate corrective action?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Service ratings below 3**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**
__
• On **01 June 2026**, the **Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)**, under the **Ministry of Labour & Employment**, rolled out a **Centralized Online Patient Feedback System** across its hospitals and dispensaries nationwide.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**
__
• The system is designed to identify critical issues by **automatically flagging any service ratings below 3**. This automated alert mechanism ensures that relevant authorities can facilitate **timely and targeted corrective actions**.
• The digital initiative allows **Insured Persons (IPs)** and beneficiaries to share feedback on service parameters like **cleanliness**, **staff behaviour**, and **medicine availability**.
• The system includes **real-time monitoring dashboards** at the Headquarters, Regional Offices, and Local ESI Health Facilities levels to ensure accountability.
• Therefore, the correct rating threshold for immediate administrative intervention is **below 3**.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
__
• Feedback can be submitted through **automated SMS links** (sent via the **Dhanwantri Module**), **On-Site QR Codes**, or the official **ESIC web portal**.
• The system features **OTP validation** and **multilingual support** to cater to India's diverse workforce while preventing duplicate feedback.
• It also supports the **performance ranking** of all healthcare facilities to promote continuous improvement and healthy competition.
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

• **Ministry:** Ministry of Labour & Employment.
• **Objective:** To ensure **patient-centric healthcare** and enhance service quality across **ESIC** facilities.
• **Core Mandate:** "ESIC – Committed to Better Healthcare."
